description: This file defines the Connection class for PostgreSQL database interactions within Drupal, implementing connection management, query execution, transaction savepoints, and database creation.

classes.name: Connection
classes.description: Implements PostgreSQL-specific database connection handling, including query execution, transaction savepoints, and database creation within Drupal.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the Connection object, sanitizing schema, setting UTF-8 encoding, and executing init commands.

methods.name: setPrefix
methods.description: Sets table prefix and schema quoting for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Establishes a new PostgreSQL connection with specified options, handling exceptions.

methods.name: query
methods.description: Executes a database query, wrapping with savepoints if in a transaction.

methods.name: prepareStatement
methods.description: Prepares a SQL statement, adjusting operators for PostgreSQL.

methods.name: queryRange
methods.description: Executes a query with LIMIT and OFFSET.

methods.name: queryTemporary
methods.description: Creates a temporary table from a query.

methods.name: driver
methods.description: Returns the driver name 'pgsql'.

methods.name: databaseType
methods.description: Returns the database type 'pgsql'.

methods.name: createDatabase
methods.description: Creates a new PostgreSQL database with locale considerations.

methods.name: mapConditionOperator
methods.description: Maps generic operators to PostgreSQL-specific operators.

methods.name: makeSequenceName
methods.description: Generates a sequence name for a table and field.

methods.name: getFullQualifiedTableName
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified table name including database and schema.

methods.name: addSavepoint
methods.description: Creates a transaction savepoint.

methods.name: releaseSavepoint
methods.description: Releases a transaction savepoint.

methods.name: rollbackSavepoint
methods.description: Rolls back to a savepoint.

methods.name: hasJson
methods.description: Checks if the database supports JSON functions.

methods.name: exceptionHandler
methods.description: Returns a new ExceptionHandler instance.

methods.name: select
methods.description: Creates a new Select query object.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Creates a new Insert query object.

methods.name: upsert
methods.description: Creates a new Upsert query object.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Creates a new Update query object.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Creates a new Delete query object.

methods.name: truncate
methods.description: Creates a new Truncate query object.

methods.name: schema
methods.description: Returns the schema object, initializing if necessary.

methods.name: driverTransactionManager
methods.description: Returns a new TransactionManager for this connection.
